# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not open a public issue or include credentials, personal data, exploit details, or production data in normal discussions.

Use the repository's private security advisory form:

https://github.com/luannguen/repoproject_standar-skilll/security/advisories/new

For a cloned project, replace this URL with that repository's private reporting channel before accepting users or production traffic.

Include affected version, impact, reproduction with sensitive values removed, and any known workaround. Maintainers should acknowledge, triage, coordinate remediation and disclosure, and never promise a public timeline before impact is understood.

## Supported versions

This template supports the current version listed in `VERSION`. An instantiated project must define its own supported-version and disclosure policy.
